conclusion: Outer selection either omits the whole feature block or keeps its original inner flags and all selected bytes. Inner selection changes flags and payload length; it cannot serialize full flags with zeroed arrays from a nonzero source block. Missing fields remain zero only when omitted by inner flags. Neither tested writer computes bit17.
scope: Generated finite owned metadata, two DRS/DSE5 feature writers/readers and Frame wrappers. All 16 array subsets tested at Frame level; 21 individual flags plus reserved-flag combinations at feature level. No original authoring caller or other serialization format is proved.

saved_selection.scope: Eight hash-pinned DDI/DDB inputs read only. Counts include repeated samples across banks; they are not independent recordings. All four arrays physically present, not reconstructed from missing flags.
